label: baseline
description: Unchanged humans, as the old ships carried them.

label: Emberkin
description: A lineage made for hot worlds: red skin, small horns and fire in the lungs.
ours: genes: the cosmetic genes (the wiki's three skin and three hair choices are one each here)

label: Frostkin
description: A lineage made for cold worlds: thick fur, a strong frame and a short temper.

label: Warbred
description: A lineage made for war: quick to heal, hard to hurt and eager to fight.
later: go-juice (rush) dependency gene, with drugs in Stage 3
the wiki gives complexity 16 on the Xenotypes page and 17 on the Hussar page

label: Ashborn
description: A lineage made for ruined worlds: gray, hard to sicken and at home in poisoned air.
later: pollution stimulus, wake-up (rush-like drug) immunity and psychite dependency genes, with pollution and drugs

label: Delver
description: A lineage made for the dark under mountains: sharp in the dark, fast to heal, slow on the surface.
